claims.claim: NVIDIA's board is initiating an independent investigation into reporting that Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA's board is initiating an independent investigation into reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort
claims.source_title: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors
claims.supporting_quote: The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.

claims.claim: Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via subsidiary Speedmatrix.
claims.episode_span: Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling two billion dollars worth of AI chips into China through its subsidiary Speedmatrix
claims.source_title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
claims.supporting_quote: Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via its subsidiary Speedmatrix.

claims.claim: A committee of independent directors assisted by outside independent counsel will oversee the investigation, and the board has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.
claims.episode_span: A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the inquiry; the board says it has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised
claims.source_title: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors
claims.supporting_quote: While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information.

claims.claim: Sister companies of Megaspeed are building data centers in Malaysia for Chinese customers.
claims.episode_span: a network of sister companies is building data centers in Malaysia for those customers
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Launches Investigation Into Jensen Huang's Relationship With Suspected Chinese Spy
claims.supporting_quote: Its network of sister companies is building data centers in Malaysia to satisfy the compute needs of Chinese customers.

claims.claim: Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, a former Megaspeed executive, was allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security.
claims.episode_span: Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, was allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security
claims.source_title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
claims.supporting_quote: U.S. intelligence agencies believe Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who was allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security (MSS) to gather information and help Chinese companies obtain restricted AI GPUs.

claims.claim: DeepX taped out a second-generation AI accelerator that can run large language models on device in under 5 W and projects a 6.7× gain with LPDDR5x-PIM.
claims.episode_span: the part can run large language models on device in under 5 W, and the company projects a 6.7× performance gain with LPDDR5x-PIM
claims.source_title: DeepX Tapes Out Second-Gen Chip, Projects 6.7× Performance Gain With LPDDR5x-PIM
claims.supporting_quote: DeepX is targeting edge markets including robotics with its second-generation AI accelerator, which can run large LLMs on device in under 5 W.

claims.claim: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration using NVLink Fusion to combine NVIDIA's platform, Rebellions' processors and SK Telecom's AI data center capabilities.
claims.episode_span: NVLink Fusion is the link that brings together NVIDIA's open infrastructure platform, Rebellions' Korean-designed AI processors, and SK Telecom's AI data center
claims.source_title: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom Announce Collaboration to Advance Sovereign AI Infrastructure With NVIDIA NVLink Fusion
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ to bring together NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform, Rebellions’ Korean-designed AI processors and SK Telecom’s AI data center, model and service capabilities.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced an investment in Point2 Technology, which builds radio-frequency interconnects between chips and racks, with further investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA announced an investment in Point2 Technology
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

claims.claim: ASRock Rack's DMRD16-2L+ can reach about 1.6 TB/s and 4 TB using sixteen 256 GB MRDIMMs at up to 12,800 MT/s, and Xeon 7 is slated for 2027 on LGA9324.
claims.episode_span: reaches a theoretical bandwidth of roughly 1.6 TB/s and 4 TB of capacity when all 16 slots hold 256 GB MRDIMMs at up to 12,800 MT/s
claims.source_title: ASRock Rack Shows Early Xeon 7 Diamond Rapids Motherboard for Up to 4 TB of DDR5
claims.supporting_quote: Populate all 16 slots with those, and you hit 4 TB, along with a theoretical bandwidth of roughly 1.6 TB/s.

claims.claim: Dell's PowerEdge R770AP is a 2U dual-socket Xeon 6 server with 24 channels of DDR5.
claims.episode_span: a 2U server built around a dual-socket Xeon 6 setup and 24 channels of DDR5
claims.source_title: Dell PowerEdge R770AP Review One Fast Intel Xeon 6 Server
claims.supporting_quote: The 2U server goes all-in on performance with a dual-socket Xeon 6 setup and 24 channels of DDR5 memory

claims.claim: Dutch police arrested 150 to 200 protesters after a Microsoft data-center construction-site protest turned violent.
claims.episode_span: Dutch police arrested 150 to 200 protesters after the action at that construction site turned violent
claims.source_title: Hundreds arrested after Microsoft data center protest turns violent
claims.supporting_quote: It's unclear which group entered the construction site first, but the action led to the arrest of 150 to 200 protesters.

claims.claim: South Korean memory capital expenditure this year is well above 100 trillion won, about $74.1 billion, versus 20 to 30 trillion won for Chinese memory companies.
claims.episode_span: South Korean memory makers' capital expenditure this year well above 100 trillion won, about $74.1 billion
claims.source_title: BofA: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix Near a 'TSMC Moment'
claims.supporting_quote: South Korean memory makers' capital expenditure this year is well above 100 trillion won (approximately $74.1 billion), while combined investment by Chinese memory companies is estimated at 20 trillion to 30 trillion won (approximately $14.8 billion to $22.2 billion).

claims.claim: YMTC held 14% of global NAND shipments in Q2 2026, eight points behind SK Hynix at 22%, and fabs 1 and 2 together run about 200,000 wafers a month.
claims.episode_span: YMTC held 14% of global NAND shipments in the second quarter of 2026
claims.source_title: BofA: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix Near a 'TSMC Moment'
claims.supporting_quote: YMTC held a 14% share of global NAND shipments in the second quarter of 2026, overtaking Kioxia to rank third worldwide for the first time.

claims.claim: New Matrix and Maginfra, approved to receive H200 chips, appear to have empty offices and ties to sanctioned Chinese military suppliers.
claims.episode_span: New Matrix and Maginfra, both approved to receive H200 chips, appear to have abandoned offices and unknown addresses
claims.source_title: Two Chinese companies cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices and unknown addresses
claims.supporting_quote: The offices for New Matrix and Maginfra, both approved to receive H200 chips, appear abandoned, and people in the buildings say they're unfamiliar with the companies or have never seen anyone working there.

claims.claim: TSMC's reported BEOL 1T1C test chip ran at 0.75 volts, retained data beyond 128 milliseconds, completed random cycles in under 8 nanoseconds, and withstood more than 10^14 program-and-erase cycles.
claims.episode_span: ran at 0.75 volts. It retained data beyond 128 milliseconds, finished random read and write cycles in under 8 nanoseconds
claims.source_title: TSMC Sidesteps DRAM Question While Quietly Building Memory Into Logic Chips
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC reported that its test chip, which combines memory and logic on a single die, ran at 0.75 volts, retained data beyond 128 milliseconds, completed random read and write cycles in under 8 nanoseconds and withstood more than 10^14 program-and-erase cycles.

claims.claim: TSMC's October sales update is due Tuesday at 1:30 p.m. Taipei time.
claims.episode_span: TSMC's October sales update is due Tuesday at 1:30 p.m. Taipei time.
claims.source_title: TSMC, SK Hynix, Samsung: Asian Chip Stocks Rise Even As Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Controversy Tests Investor Confidence
claims.supporting_quote: Meanwhile, TSMC's monthly sales update, due on Tuesday at 1:30 p.m. Taipei time, will also be in focus.
